title: transient-pool-custodian-and-concurrency-spectator
author: Sara Nguyen
description:
Motivation: Dedicated fleets often accumulate underutilized transient capacity (short-lived prewarmed slots and ephemeral warmlets) that increases cost and skews utilization signals. This PR introduces a lightweight controller — the Transient Pool Custodian — that reclaims idle ephemeral reservations, compacts lease fragments, and emits a summarized telemetry rollup designed for downstream autoscalers. Additionally, the Concurrency Spectator samples per-tenant inflight concurrency at low overhead and publishes percentile-based signals so autoscalers and SLO monitors can reason about concurrency distributions instead of relying on coarse averages.

What this PR does (summary):
- Add a new controller services/fleet/custodian.go implementing passive sweep and lease compaction policy with configurable thresholds and soft-probe backoff.
- Introduce a Concurrency Spectator that samples active RPCs per-tenant and exposes 50/90/99 percentile histograms under metrics/tenant_concurrency_histogram.go.
- Emit compact telemetry artifacts: compressed reservation snapshots (bucketed by age/size/tenant-tier) and a utilization delta summary to reduce cardinality in long-term stores.
- Wire new feature flags and Helm values: transientPool.enabled, custodian.idleThresholdSeconds, spectator.samplingRate.
- Add e2e tests and fuzz case covering race between lease reclaim and in-flight attach (to prevent races that cause double-assignment).
- Documentation: ops/transient-pool.md explains runtime knobs and recommended autoscaler mappings.

Design notes:
- The custodian is conservative: it only reclaims leases that are idle for > idleThresholdSeconds and have zero attached sessions for two consecutive sweep windows. It uses a soft-lease-compact step (mark -> grace -> reclaim) to avoid preempting slowly-surfacing attach events.
- The Concurrency Spectator uses reservoir sampling per-tenant with a global rate cap to guarantee bounded CPU/memory overhead. Percentiles are computed in process and exported as histogram metrics to reduce cardinality growth.
- Telemetry artifacts are emitted at reduced cardinality: tenant-tier + age-bucket + pool-id. This intentionally avoids high-cardinality labels (session IDs, request IDs).

Compatibility and upgrade:
- Backwards compatible: flags default to disabled (transientPool.enabled=false) so clusters will not change behavior unless opt-in.
- The custodian coordinates via existing lease annotations; no DB schema changes required.
- Rollback: set transientPool.enabled=false and custodian.graceWindowSeconds to a large value to let leases re-accumulate.

Testing and verification:
- Unit tests cover lease selection, grace flow, and spectator sampling edge cases.
- Integration: local k8s test harness with injected synthetic tenants validated that reclaim reduces idle slots by ~18% in our synthetic workload and that spectator percentile signals track tail concurrency during spike windows.
- Load: bench harness (benchmark-lab) run against a 50-node dedicated pool; CPU/latency overhead of spectator <1% at default sampling.

Checklist: 
- [x] Controller implementation + tests
- [x] Metrics + Prometheus exposition
- [x] Documentation and helm values
- [x] Bench and integration validation
- [x] Reviewed and approved

Notes for reviewers: look closely at services/fleet/custodian.go reconciliation loop (stability under high churn) and metrics/tenant_concurrency_histogram.go (ensure no cardinality explosion). The e2e sim (tests/e2e/transient_custodian_test.go) includes a deterministic seed to reproduce the race case reported in SUP-321.

ci_checks: Initial CI: lint failed (unused var in telemetry_rollup.go). Fix: removed dead code. Tests: unit (24/24), integration (6/6), e2e (1/1 flaky seed-fixed). Bench: microbench transient_pool_bench passed with spectator overhead <1%. Prometheus metrics validated by perf-canary job. Final CI: all checks passed.
release_notes: Add optional Transient Pool Custodian to reclaim idle ephemeral reservations and a Concurrency Spectator to publish tenant-level concurrency percentiles. Disabled by default; operators can enable via helm value transientPool.enabled. Improves cost efficiency and provides richer tail-concurrency signals for autoscalers.
testing: Unit + integration + e2e included. Bench runs against 50-node local pool demonstrate ~18% idle slot reduction and negligible runtime overhead. Tests added: TestCustodianReclaimGrace, TestSpectatorReservoirBounds, TestRaceAttachDuringReclaim.
upgrade_instructions: 1) Deploy charts with transientPool.enabled=false and validate. 2) Enable spectator.samplingRate=0.01 in controlled environment to observe metrics for 24h. 3) Gradually enable transientPool.enabled=true and set custodian.idleThresholdSeconds per tenant tier. 4) Monitor telemetry_rollup utilization_delta metric and watch for unexpected reclaim events. To rollback, flip transientPool.enabled=false.
merge_summary: Squash merged into main by release-bot after approvals from Rahul, Jenna, and Luca. No post-merge hotfixes required. Changelog entry added under docs/CHANGELOG.md.
